description: This pie chart visually represents the distribution of categories across which Large Language Models are evaluated, with each slice corresponding to a specific domain and labeled with its percentage share. The chart contains twelve distinct slices, each with a unique color and a percentage value indicated by a label connected via a line. The largest slice, colored blue, represents AI/NLP Research at 24.3%. Following this, the teal slice represents Science at 6.7%. Other notable slices include Daily Life at 7.1%, Med & Health at 6.7%, History at 8.2%, and Game&Animation at 8.2%. Smaller segments include Business at 5.9%, Law at 5.1%, Pet & Animal at 5.5%, and Geography at 2.7%. The smallest slice, colored dark green, represents Math at 1.2%. The chart includes a legend-like structure where each category label and its percentage are connected to its corresponding slice by a line, and the slices are arranged in a clockwise order, generally from largest to smallest, though not strictly descending. There are no exploded slices or bolded text; all slices appear as standard wedges of the pie.
